questions.q: What is Microsoft Defender XDR, and what was it previously called?
options: Microsoft's cross-domain detection and response platform, previously named Microsoft 365 Defender before a 2023 rename
A standalone antivirus engine unrelated to any other Microsoft product
The old name for Microsoft Sentinel before Sentinel was released
A Linux-only endpoint protection agent
questions.explain: Microsoft Defender XDR was renamed from Microsoft 365 Defender in 2023; both names refer to the same unified portal at security.microsoft.com.

questions.q: Which four Defender workloads feed into Defender XDR's unified incident view?
options: Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365, Defender for Identity, and Defender for Cloud Apps
Defender Antivirus, Windows Firewall, BitLocker, and Windows Update
Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and KQL
Only Defender for Endpoint — the other three are unrelated products
questions.explain: Those four workloads — endpoint, email/collaboration, on-prem identity, and cloud apps — are the signal sources Defender XDR correlates.

questions.q: In the lesson's attack-chain example, which Defender workload would flag the Pass-the-Hash attempt against a domain controller?
options: Defender for Identity
Defender for Office 365
Defender for Cloud Apps
Defender for Endpoint
questions.explain: Defender for Identity watches on-prem Active Directory domain controllers, which is exactly where a Pass-the-Hash attempt against a DC would be seen.

questions.q: Why does correlating a multi-product attack into one Defender XDR incident matter more than reviewing each product's alerts separately?
options: Because the same attack can touch email, identity, and endpoint, and without correlation each touchpoint looks like an unrelated, low-priority alert on its own
Because Defender for Endpoint alone can never detect anything without the other three products enabled
Because each Defender product shows exactly the same alerts as the others, making correlation redundant
Because correlation is required before any of the four products can raise an alert at all
questions.explain: A real attack chain crosses product boundaries; Defender XDR's correlation turns four disconnected-looking alerts into one coherent attack story.

questions.q: What is the relationship between Defender XDR and Microsoft Sentinel, per this lesson?
options: Defender XDR's unified incident view is not a replacement for Sentinel — Sentinel can ingest Defender XDR's incidents and raw event tables through a connector
Defender XDR and Sentinel are two unrelated products with no way to connect
Sentinel is simply an older name for Defender XDR
Defender XDR fully replaces the need for Microsoft Sentinel in every environment
questions.explain: The next lesson covers the real Sentinel connector that ingests Defender XDR incidents and underlying tables for further correlation with non-Microsoft data.
